purpose: 웹·파이프라인·현장 설치/구동 개발을 증거와 복구 경계 안에서 수행한다.

preparation: inspect repository, branch, commit, interfaces, DB, UI, environment and protected assets
pipeline checks inputs, sample IDs, parameters, parser, references, mounts, image, expected outputs and dry-run plan
field work checks closed network, OS, Docker, GPU, disk, offline packages, checksums, services and rollback
execution: preserve protected sources, results, images and running jobs
separate local reversible work from approved external operations
verification: web: static, unit, integration, API, DB and render checks are labeled separately
pipeline: input contract, parser, mounts, expected manifest, dry-run and representative end-to-end checks
field: actual runtime, service, API and sample output; static inspection is not execution PASS
completion: record changed files, version, commands, evidence, remaining limits and rollback
commit or push only when explicitly approved
